audit.why: Xerath out-ranges Ryze at every point of the laning phase: Arcanopulse (Q) 750 base charged range and Eye of Destruction (W) 1000 against Overload (Q) 1000 but Rune Prison (W) and Spell Flux (E) at only 615. Difficulty 4/10 and 56.83% win rate over 1515 games match the FAVOURED label. Side lane and teamfight ownership flips late once Ryze has stacks and items.
audit.corrected: Lane FAVOURED for Xerath through first item; teamfights and late game favour Ryze.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[6].side read 'Skill' while content win[6] read 'Ryze' — the two layers rendered different answers for the 2+ items row, and phases[6].why described Xerath winning that stage.
audit.why: Packet levelChart[6] is Ryze, content whys[6] and the late field both say Ryze takes over at 2+ items. The full layer was stale.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing on the page said Ryze can interrupt Rite of the Arcane (R). Xerath's R carries the channel flag ('interruptible — any CC cancels it') and Ryze's Rune Prison roots when the target already has Flux on it.
audit.why: Xerath immobilises himself for the whole R. Ryze at 615 range with Spell Flux (E, 3.5s at rank 1) into Rune Prison (W, 11s at rank 1) has a root inside that window, and a root cancels the channel.
audit.corrected: Stated in phases[4].why and breakdown.cooldowns: ult only after his W is spent, and watch the E, not the W, because the W only roots on a Flux-marked target.

edits.before: - Ryze Rune Prison (Root): matchup-defining — Point-blank root — respect the EQ chain that follows it. It governs your forward steps. - E Shocking Orb spent on poke is a death you scheduled. - Hold the R for the fight that decides something.
edits.after: - Rune Prison (W) is 615 range on 11s at rank 1 and only roots a target Spell Flux already marked — watch the E, not the W. - Shocking Orb (E) is 13s; spent on poke it is a death you scheduled. - Rite of the Arcane is 130s at rank 1.
